description.value: Pita Pit is a Canadian fast-food chain specializing in freshly made pita sandwiches, salads, and rice bowls built from a wide array of toppings and fillings. This Nanaimo location sits in the Country Club Centre on North Island Highway and also offers smoothies, catering platters, and a loyalty rewards app. For touring cyclists moving through Nanaimo, it is a convenient quick-service stop with takeout and delivery available.
